title: Add component-level SLO dashboards + standard links for status page components
author: Aisha Bello
description: Context: As part of the Status Page Transparency Upgrades initiative, on-call needs a consistent, component-level view of latency + error impact that matches the public status component taxonomy (component_id x region x capability). Today dashboards are a mix of service names (gateway/scheduler/streamer), inconsistent region labels, and ad-hoc links in runbooks. This PR adds a standardized dashboard set per status component and a link registry so alerts/runbooks/status tooling can point to the same canonical URLs. What’s in this PR: (1) New Grafana dashboards for each public status component, split into latency + errors with consistent panels and templating. (2) Standard naming conventions for dashboards, folders, variables, and panel titles (to reduce “is this the right chart?” time during Sev1). (3) A generated link map (component_id/region/capability -> dashboard URL) committed under observability-pack so it can be referenced from alert annotations and the status-page update runbook. (4) Basic validation to ensure every active component in the registry has a dashboard link entry (fails CI if missing). Scope/Components: Hosted API (chat/completions), Streaming, Embeddings, Reranking, Console (incident surfacing + status endpoints), plus region views for us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1. Notes: Dedicated/Private are intentionally excluded from the public-facing component dashboard set in this PR; we can add internal-only dashboards later under a separate folder with restricted perms. Naming convention: Folder = "Status Components"; Dashboard title = "Status Component: <Display Name> (<region>)"; UID = "statuscomp-<component_id>-<region>"; Variables include component_id, region, capability (where applicable), route_group. Panels standardize on p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate (5m/30m), request volume, saturation proxy (queue depth where available), and top routes contributing to errors. Validation/rollout: This is safe to merge behind the current component registry; new components will require link entries, but the check only enforces for components marked rollout_enabled=true. Follow-ups: The anti-flap logic PR will reference these dashboards in alert annotations; the status-page update runbook will also be updated to prefer the canonical links from this repo.

conversation: Allison Grant (review): This is the right direction. Two asks: (a) can we standardize the variable names to match the public taxonomy exactly (component_id/region/capability) and (b) can we add a panel for “top contributing routes” so Comms Lead can sanity check impact scope before posting? Aisha Bello (author): Updated to use component_id/region/capability everywhere; added Top Routes panel based on route_group tags where present, and a fallback “top endpoint” query for gateway-only components. Rafael Mendes (review): Love the CI guardrail. One concern: the dashboards for Streaming are using gateway error rate; we need streaming disconnect/error counters when available, otherwise we’ll mark impact incorrectly. Can we split Streaming into its own error source query and label it accordingly? Aisha Bello (author): Good catch. Streaming dashboard now uses streaming_disconnect_rate + streaming_stream_errors when present; the panel header calls out the metric source and includes a note when falling back to gateway 5xx (only for regions that don’t have the new metric yet). Christine Wong (review): Please align the dashboard titles to what we’ll show on the status page (e.g., “Streaming API” vs “Streaming”). Also can we ensure the UID is stable and won’t churn when display names change? Aisha Bello (author): Titles now include the public display name from the component registry; UID stays derived from component_id + region (display name changes won’t affect it). Mina Haddad (review): Region naming: can we use the canonical region ids (us-east-1) consistently and avoid “use1/usw2” abbreviations? Also, I’d like a per-region overview dashboard for quick triage. Aisha Bello (author): All dashboards standardized to canonical region ids. Added a “Status Components: Region Overview” dashboard with a table of key KPIs per component for the selected region. Allison Grant (final): Approved. Please add a short README section describing how to add a new component and how to fetch the canonical link from the registry. Aisha Bello (author): Added README/status-components-dashboards.md with steps + examples.
release_notes: Internal: Adds standardized Grafana dashboards and canonical dashboard links for each public status component (latency + errors), aligned to component_id/region/capability taxonomy.
